blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — On September 29, next week, local fuel prices may decrease. This as optimism grows for a supply increase and a potential renewal of peace talks between the United States and Iran. Seven pesos to P7.50 per liter may be cut from the the price of diesel, said Jetti Petroleum president Leo Bellas in an advisory.
